schedule_id.meaning: Schedule id; HTTP reads schedule_id and the CLI uses its positional id.

calendar.meaning: If calendar is an object its fields are used; otherwise the patch itself supplies calendar fields.

time.meaning: Local time in HH:MM; at is its fallback.

weekday.meaning: Weekly requires Mon through Sun; daily ignores weekday, including null.

day.meaning: Fallback for weekday; weekly accepts Mon through Sun.

enabled.meaning: Optional enabled state when the top-level enabled field is absent; null preserves the prior state and a malformed present value is treated as false.

readback.meaning: Status view after the operation, including schedule, next_fire, last_fire and baseline.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: <raw SQLite or filesystem error text>, <stored JSON parser error text>, and pid2-invalid-json: <parser message> on HTTP. Also protocol-kernel-field-missing:<field>, protocol-kernel-definition-missing:<index>, and pid2-command-wake-persist-failed: <error>. The CLI update also passes through <raw stdin JSON parser error text>.
